objective: Mitigate extrapolation in zones without observed second-round votes without using final election results.

rules.input: Same synchronized and matched 1T/2T ledger contract as v4.1.
rules.zero_sample_zone: When a zone has no paired first-round denominator for either candidate, use a conservative common multiplier: sum of observed second-round A+B votes divided by sum of paired first-round A+B votes, applied equally to A and B in that zone.
rules.nonzero_zone: Preserve original V4 local candidate-specific multipliers; candidate-specific zero denominators fall back to global as V4.
rules.physical_bounds: Preserve original V4 deterministic vote-cap scaling and abstention contracts.
rules.prediction: Compute candidate A share after adding predicted unseen votes. Never access final result during prediction.

evaluation.external_gate: Do not promote without a newly selected independent test set frozen before its results are opened; require MAE and max no worse than baseline in each case and no wrong winner call at 5%.

limitations: 2024 development cases already known; no independent proof.
Retrospective first-totalization data are not authenticated public snapshots.
This protocol does not claim certification.
